subject: BlueForge onboarding: PO requirement and temporary invoice-only request
messages:

Cc: procurement@blueforge.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on PO requirement for trial/pilot

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at BlueForge is excited about the latency and cost numbers you showed. We want to get a short pilot contract in place to run 2TB of anonymized logs through your hosted API. Procurement on our side is asking whether Redwood requires a purchase order for pilots under $10k, or if we can do an invoice-only arrangement for a 30–60 day pilot.

I've attached our proposed SOW (BlueForge_SOW_v1.pdf) and an onboarding form to this message. If you can confirm Redwood's policy and any evidence you need (W-9, insurance cert, signed SOW/NDA), we can move quickly. We prefer invoice-only for pilots to avoid internal PO cycle delays.

Best,
Aisha
Director of Partnerships
BlueForge Analytics

Attachments: BlueForge_SOW_v1.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@blueforge.ai>
Cc: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for trial/pilot

Hi Aisha — great to hear, and thanks for sending the SOW. Looping in Priyom (procurement) and Marissa (onboarding) to confirm the intake path.

Short answer: Redwood's standard policy is to require a purchase order for engagements that are covered under a master services agreement (MSA) and/or expected spend > $5k/month. For small pilots we do sometimes permit an invoice-only path on a temporary basis, but that requires an internal exception and a few documents: signed SOW, W-9 (or equivalent), COI (insurance), and an approved temporary-payments ticket from procurement.

If BlueForge can provide the onboarding form + W-9 and COI, I can escalate for a 60-day invoice-only approval so you can start ASAP. Priyom — can you confirm what evidence you need and whether a 60-day exception is reasonable for DF-4832? Marissa — once we get procurement sign-off, please advise what account setup steps you need from BlueForge.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for trial/pilot

Thanks Markus — Priyom here. A few clarifications from procurement:

- Thresholds: We normally require a PO for commitments > $5k/month or any subscription-style billing. One-off professional services or ad-hoc pilots under $5k can be reviewed for invoice-only.
- Evidence: mandatory: completed onboarding form, U.S. W-9 (or VAT details for non-US entities), certificate of insurance (COI) naming Redwood as additional insured for the pilot duration.
- Risk controls: For invoice-only exceptions we add a 60-day cap and hold final payment until SOW deliverables are validated. We also require the sales lead to take responsibility for collection risk (i.e., internal credit hold if overdue).

Operationally, to process the exception quickly we need: the completed onboarding form, SOW signed by both parties, and a W-9/COI. If BlueForge can provide these by tomorrow EOD, I can approve a 60-day invoice-only path and open the vendor record in our AP system with a temporary status.

Marissa — once Priyom confirms, we'll need the vendor intake packet and the billing contact so Accounts Payable can route invoices to the temporary account.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@blueforge.ai>
To: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 15:22:00 -07:00

Thanks Priyom — that's clear and reasonable. We're attaching the completed onboarding form now (BlueForge_Onboarding_Form.xlsx) and have the W-9 and COI ready — I can send those after internal approval in the next hour.

One operational ask: can we get the 60-day invoice-only approval in place by COB tomorrow so we can start the pilot on Monday? We'll sign the SOW in DocuSign as soon as we receive the link. If helpful, I can also have our finance lead (procurement@blueforge.ai) standby to confirm billing details.

On the SOW: we're proposing a capped pilot spend of $3,500 for the 30-day run; if we extend to 60 days we expect up to $6,500 — which I know approaches the threshold. If an internal cap helps, we're happy to set an explicit 60-day cap and escrow hold on final deliverables.

Best,
Aisha
